'''Yunji Oryn''' was an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. When the base he was assigned to was attacked and badly damaged, Oryn designed a prototype [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] system using [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines from damaged [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], part of a burnt-out [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]], and ancient [[Missile/Legends|rockets]]. The weapon system was known as the [[RAX-1|RAGOC]]; Repulsor-Assisted Ground-to-Orbit Concussion Missile Launcher. Oryn formed [[Oryn Engineering]] and refined the design, eventually producing the production model [[RAX-1]].<ref name="HS" />
